facts.fact: The Auditor-General reports that at Gwanda Municipality 27 stands sold in 2019 were still not being billed and the valuation roll was not yet finalised, which shows a billing record of stands that is incomplete.

The Auditor-General reports that a council whose name the extracted passages do not carry had not identified and corrected stands not yet in its billing system, and its valuation roll was not complete; its management said it was updating the stands register.
facts.system: council billing system (council not named in passages)

facts.fact: Tongogara Rural District Council's management told the Auditor-General the council maintains a register of sold stands and that an on-going valuation roll exercise will update registers of both sold and unsold stands.
